name: Bank Transaction - Normalise Signs
script:
# Bank statements (CSV/Excel import) can show money out as a negative number.
# ERPNext does not reject negative deposit/withdrawal, so normalise them here.
# MT940 imports are already converted correctly by ERPNext.
flt = frappe.utils.flt

if doc.docstatus < 2:
    # Bank shows money out as a negative number - store it as a positive withdrawal
    if flt(doc.withdrawal) < 0:
        doc.withdrawal = abs(flt(doc.withdrawal))

    # A negative deposit is really money going out
    if flt(doc.deposit) < 0:
        doc.withdrawal = flt(doc.withdrawal) + abs(flt(doc.deposit))
        doc.deposit = 0

    # A bank line is either money in or money out, never both
    if flt(doc.deposit) > 0 and flt(doc.withdrawal) > 0:
        frappe.throw("A bank transaction can't have both a deposit and a withdrawal. Please check this statement line.")
